query: Which capture–recapture model selection (log-linear with interaction terms) and diagnostics will we predefine to estimate underreporting and source dependence?

response.query: Which capture–recapture model selection (log-linear with interaction terms) and diagnostics will we predefine to estimate underreporting and source dependence?
response.answer: To estimate underreporting and source dependence, use log-linear capture–recapture models with interaction terms. Model selection will involve comparing different log-linear models using AIC or BIC. Diagnostics will include goodness-of-fit tests and residual analysis.
